text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Help us, Miss Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy. I'm guessing it's study<n>troubles again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! If I flunk this test, I'll have to<n>take extra
classes!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No cap, I'm feeling pressed here! The<n>whole
situation's high-key hectic!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm happy to help you with your<n>studies, but...
Hm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll help you two out, but on one<n>condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sure! Anything you say! Just lay it on<n>us!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want you to look through the<n>textbook and try to
guess which<n>questions are going to come up in the
test!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's a yikes! I don't even<n>remember what kinda
questions the<n>last test had!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not budging on this, okay? I have<n>work and
training to do, so I can't<n>just teach you everything.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmeirinha, it's time to pop off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I mean, we'll be taking up<n>some of your, like,
precious time, so<n>we should make sure we do this
properly!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, when I drop by the<n>library to do
some research...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gahhh?! My work's not braining!<n>Every question
looks just like the<n>last one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Totally. It's like they're justtaking the same numbers andsymbols and... shuffling themaround...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Helios! All these problems are<n>literally the
same format! You can<n>solve them all exactly the
same way!<n>So that means...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Teach must love this type of question!<n>It's like
they're in a super-sticky<n>situationship. No cap,
we're low-key<n>detectives for figuring that out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, yes! So now we just gotta find<n>more
questions to test ourselves on!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Using their own brand of trial and<n>error, the two
work hard to meet<n>"Miss" Ines's conditions. Then,
a few<n>days later...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That was such a tasty meal! By the<n>way, I've got
some free time after<n>this, Trainer, so—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ines! There you are! Are you down<n>for a quick yap
sesh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, about the potential exam<n>questions—the two of
us gave it a<n>serious think, for real!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right. So, what questions are you<n>expecting?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The second question on page forty...<n>and questions
five to ten on page<n>fifty-two! What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow. So why did you pick these?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, when we checked our notes<n>from class, there
were these<n>highlighted bits, right? Like, they were
giving rainbow with all the different<n>colors we used.
☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And I was like, "Wait, what are these<n>colors even
for?" but then I<n>remembered we're supposed to
watch out for trick questions!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Teach stans those really complicated<n>ones, right?
But if we just remember<n>the formula, we can stay
on point!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. So, you remember the<n>formula now?
Okay, so... Are there<n>any questions you couldn't
figure<n>out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
There kinda aren't?! I get them all!<n>That's wild. So
we were<n>galaxy-brained the whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow. Well, that's a shame. I had<n>some tips and
tricks ready for you<n>and everything.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm high-key sorry about this!<n>But if you
ever feel like you don't<n>understand the assignment,
Ines,<n>just @ me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what a handful.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Me too. Their hard work really paid<n>off there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, they would've gotten there<n>faster if I'd
taught them that stuff<n>right away.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But that wouldn't have helped them<n>in the long run.
Still...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Judging from their attitude at the end<n>there, I'm
sure they'll be fine—even if<n>I'm not around to help
next time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what a reliefy-lief. Problem<n>solved. ♪
choice_data_list:
Do you feel a little sad that they won't need your
help?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what a reliefy-lief. Problem<n>solved. ♪
choice_data_list:
Do you feel a little sad that they won't need your
help?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you trying to study my<n>teaching skills?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to do that! Everyone<n>has their own
way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'm pretty fond of the way<n>you teach. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh, there is that. It's like they'reflying the nest.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I wonder how I'll fare whenit's my sisters' turn...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Scratch that! This is what growing up<n>is all about! If
anything, I should be<n>happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've got to ready myself for when<n>that day
inevitably comes!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that her big sister duties<n>won't last
forever, Ines Fujin braces<n>herself for the future.
